name: Kagome
description: A woven-basket lattice: hexagon outlines touching corner to corner, the triangles between them closing into rows of six-pointed stars.

code.style: --rule: ( @y(even) { -webkit-transform: translateX(50%); transform: translateX(50%); } @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--ring); clip-path: @var(--ring); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -100%; top: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--ring); clip-path: @var(--ring); opacity: @match(x == 1, 1, 0); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --ring: polygon(0% 50%, 25% 0%, 75% 0%, 100% 50%, 75% 100%, 25% 100%, 0% 50%, 11.18% 50%, 31.18% 90%, 68.82% 90%, 88.82% 50%, 68.82% 10%, 31.18% 10%, 11.18% 50%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
